what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Malawi in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1779 Malawian asylum seekers, and Israel hosted 44.5% of them.
After Israel, the largest hosts are South Africa, Ireland and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Malawi, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2008, 2012 to 2013 and 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 5 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 8206, at the end of 2008.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
